title: ASARS v0.1
description: Autonomous Systems Audit Receipt Standard version 0.1.0

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt. UUID v4.

schema_version.description: ASARS schema version this receipt conforms to.

timestamp_utc.description: Receipt generation timestamp in UTC. ISO 8601 format.

sequence_id.description: Monotonically increasing position in the receipt chain.

observation_layer.description: Architectural layer at which the event was captured.

pid.description: Process ID at time of observation.

ancestry_chain.description: Full process ancestry from init to observed process.

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address for network events.

destination_hostname.description: Resolved hostname if available at observation time.

outcome.description: Whether the event was allowed or blocked.

latency_ns.description: Time in nanoseconds from syscall entry to receipt generation.

prev_receipt_id.description: receipt_id of the preceding receipt. GENESIS for the first receipt.

prev_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the preceding receipt JSON, hex-encoded. 64 zeros for genesis.

chain_hash.description: SHA-256 of concatenation of prev_receipt_id and current attestation.signature, hex-encoded.

simulation.description: REQUIRED. false if hardware-signed. true if software-signed. May not be omitted.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the receipt payload, hex-encoded.

public_key_hint.description: Short identifier for the signing key.

pcr_sealed.description: true if signing key is PCR-sealed to boot state.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of all fields except attestation.signature and chain.chain_hash, hex-encoded.
